note_fr: Plutôt bon dans l'ensemble. Je suis plus à l'aise à trader la session de Londres, quand le prix vient chercher des zones d'intérêt de la session asiatique passée. Le matin je note 9/10. note_en: Pretty good overall. I'm more comfortable trading the London session, when price comes back to areas of interest from the previous Asian session. Morning: 9/10. In the afternoon, during the New York session, I'm weaker: I struggle to control my stress and markets are much more volatile, which pushes me to take a lot of risk: 3/10. I took dangerous trades; I'm really going to avoid trading when volatility is too high. Otherwise a good day, with a huge profit for a 25k account (maybe a few too many trades). Satisfied overall.

note_en: Like yesterday, I FOMO'd in the New York session. Otherwise I did well in London: I managed to wait for my setups, unlike yesterday. It's a smaller day than yesterday, but at least I didn't FOMO in the morning. On my loss (#29), like most of my losses, I tried to anticipate an absorption that never came: I tried to be smarter than the market without reading the data or waiting for my confirmations.

note_en: A winning day, but not a clean one. In the morning, I FOMO'd a short at the low and doubled my size (2 MNQ) to pass the eval faster: that's a mistake, even though the trade won. Then a misclick: a market order instead of a limit. My best trade is the simplest one: a long at −1σ after a double bottom, with confirmation. In the afternoon, I traded the New York open even though I had told myself not to. Lesson: a good result doesn't make up for a bad decision. Tomorrow: fewer trades, and only my setup.
